name: US 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Rate
description: Daily 10-Year Treasury Yield benchmark from FRED macro time-series

etl.script:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

raw_data = fetch_data('https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=DGS10')
lines = raw_data.strip().split('\n')
data = [l.split(',') for l in lines[1:] if len(l.split(',')) == 2 and l.split(',')[1] != '.']
df = pd.DataFrame(data, columns=['timestamp', 'rate'])
df['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(df['timestamp'])
df['rate'] = df['rate'].astype(float)
result_arrow = df
